build_FeatureAlign_module: build a FeatureAlign module using DeformConv2d to align features with predicted bbox offsets
build_FoveaHead_detector: build a FoveaHead anchor-free object detection head with configurable deformable convolution support
run_forward_single_FoveaHead: run forward_single on FoveaHead to get cls_score and bbox_pred from single scale features
run_loss_by_feat_FoveaHead: run loss_by_feat on FoveaHead to compute classification and bounding box losses for training
run_bbox_decode_FoveaHead: run _bbox_decode on FoveaHead to decode predicted bbox deltas into final bounding boxes
